tasks.contract: Update an inclusive-exclusive interval of a supplied [8]int by index, preserving other elements; invalid bounds leave it unchanged.
tasks.original_reason: Ardan template1 copies a populated array and prints element values/addresses; example3 contrasts range-value and element addresses. Neither requests in-array interval updates, invalid-bound atomicity or range-copy debugging. Retaining their print/copy operation would assess a different contract. Existing selected Exercism practice/resistor-color remains a valid introductory lookup/enumeration seed. It does not require writing array elements or diagnose modifying only the range-value copy. Choosing it for the specific mutable interval outcome would replace that outcome or amount to nominal reuse; retain that candidate for later lookup practice rather than claiming it unsuitable in general.
